crossRefs.note: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.
He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.
A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will bear fruit.
In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.

translations.web: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.
translations.bsb: For there is hope for a tree: If it is cut down, it will sprout again, and its tender shoots will not fail.
translations.kjv: For there is hope of a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again, and that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
translations.asv: For there is hope of a tree, If it be cut down, that it will sprout again, And that the tender branch thereof will not cease.
